translations.literal: Eight men of the Divine Guard including Zhao Yanshun plotted to kill Zhaoshou but did not yet dare act.
translations.idiomatic: Eight soldiers of the Divine Guard led by Zhao Yanshun plotted to kill Zhaoshou but did not yet dare strike.

sentences.zh: 三年正旦，中使自峨眉山還京，昭壽戒馭吏具鞍馬將送之，延順等悉解廄中馬韁，奔逸庭下，陽逐喧呼，登廳執昭壽殺之，並殺二僕，據甲仗庫，取兵器。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of the third year, a palace envoy was returning to the capital from Emei Mountain; Zhaoshou ordered the carriage clerks to prepare saddles and horses to escort him; Yanshun and the others all loosed the reins of the horses in the stable, which bolted into the courtyard; they feigned pursuit with shouts, ascended the hall, seized Zhaoshou and killed him, also killed two servants, occupied the armory, and took weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the third year a palace envoy was returning from Mount Emei; Zhaoshou ordered his staff to prepare horses to escort him. Yanshun and his men loosed every horse in the stable so they stampeded into the courtyard, then feigned pursuit with loud cries, rushed into the hall, seized Zhaoshou and killed him along with two servants, seized the armory, and took up weapons.

sentences.zh: 都監王澤聞之，急召本軍都虞候王均率兵擒捕。

translations.literal: Overall supervisor Wang Ze heard of it and urgently summoned the army's colonel Wang Jun to lead troops to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Overall supervisor Wang Ze heard the commotion and urgently summoned the army colonel Wang Jun to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 延順左執昭壽首，右操劍，仿徨無所適，卒見均至，即與眾推均為帥，合驍猛、威武兵為亂。

translations.literal: Yanshun held Zhaoshou's head in his left hand and a sword in his right, wandered with nowhere to go; when at last he saw Jun arrive, he and the crowd at once pushed Jun as commander, and united the Valiant Fierce and Martial Awesome troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshun held Zhaoshou's head in his left hand and a sword in his right, wandering in confusion; when Wang Jun arrived the mutineers at once proclaimed him their leader and rallied the Valiant Fierce and Martial Awesome regiments in open revolt.

sentences.zh: 牛冕洎轉運使張適奔漢州。

translations.literal: Niu Mian together with transport commissioner Zhang Shi fled to Hanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Mian and transport commissioner Zhang Shi fled to Hanzhou.

sentences.zh: 是秋，官兵討平之。

translations.literal: That autumn government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn government forces suppressed the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 見《雷有終傳》。

translations.literal: See the "Biography of Lei Youzhong."
translations.idiomatic: See the "Biography of Lei Youzhong."

sentences.zh: 昭壽子承諒，娶齊王女嘉興縣主，至內殿承制。

translations.literal: Zhaoshou's son Chengliang married the Princess of Jiaxing, daughter of the Prince of Qi, and rose to drafter within the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoshou's son Chengliang married the Princess of Jiaxing, daughter of the Prince of Qi, and rose to become an inner-palace drafter.

sentences.zh: 論曰：五季之亂，內則權臣擅命，外則藩鎮握兵。

translations.literal: The commentary says: In the disorder of the Five Dynasties, within the court powerful ministers usurped command, and without the military governors held the armies.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: During the chaos of the Five Dynasties, powerful ministers seized authority within the court while military governors held the armies on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 宋興，內外廓清，若天去其疾，或納節以備宿衛，或請老以奉朝請。

translations.literal: When Song arose, within and without were cleared, as if Heaven removed its affliction; some surrendered their seals to serve as palace guards, others requested retirement to attend court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song arose, the realm was cleared within and without as if Heaven had lifted a sickness; some surrendered their command seals to serve in the palace guards, others retired to attend regular court audiences.

sentences.zh: 雖太祖善禦，諸臣知機，要亦否極而泰之象也。

translations.literal: Although the Taizu was skilled in control and the various ministers knew the moment, in essence this was also the image of extreme denial giving way to peace.
translations.idiomatic: Though Taizu governed skillfully and his ministers knew when to yield, this was above all the turning from utter disorder to renewal.

sentences.zh: 彥卿一門二后，累朝襲寵，有謀善戰，聲振殊俗，與時進退，其名將之賢者歟？

translations.literal: Yanqing's house produced two empresses, enjoyed favor across successive reigns, had stratagem and excelled in battle, and his fame shook foreign peoples; advancing and retreating with the times — was he not among the worthy of famous generals?
translations.idiomatic: Yanqing's family produced two empresses and enjoyed favor through successive reigns; resourceful and formidable in battle, his fame reached foreign peoples, and he advanced and withdrew with the times — was he not among the greatest of renowned generals?

sentences.zh: 令坤、延釗素與太祖親善，平荊、湘則南服底定，鎮常山則北邊載寧，未嘗恃舊與功以啟嫌隙。

translations.literal: Lingkun and Yanzhao had long been on intimate terms with the Taizu; pacifying Jing and Xiang, the southern regions were thereby settled; governing Changshan, the northern frontier was thereby tranquil; they never relied on old ties and merit to provoke suspicion and rifts.
translations.idiomatic: Lingkun and Yanzhao had long been close to Taizu; one pacified Jing and Xiang and settled the south, the other held Changshan and kept the north secure, and neither ever traded on old friendship or merit to breed suspicion.

sentences.zh: 創業君臣有過人者，類如是夫。

translations.literal: Among the founding sovereign and ministers there were those who surpassed others — they were generally of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Among the founding emperor and his ministers there were men who rose above the ordinary, and they were generally of this sort.
